tasks.title: RTK accuracy versus baseline length
tasks.solution: 1 ppm = 1 mm per 1 km: error = 1 cm + 0.1 cm/km · d. At 20 km it is 3 cm, at 60 km 7 cm, which is why the station is chosen closer than 50–100 km.

tasks.title: Moving-baseline heading error
tasks.solution: σ_yaw = atan(σ_rel / L): 1 cm over 1 m gives 0.57°, the same 1 cm over 30 cm gives 1.9°. Hence the ArduPilot wiki's recommendation of ≥ 30 cm between the antennas (the code rejects only < 5 cm); the 0.4° in the F9P data sheet is given in a table without a baseline length (the length dependence is in a separate figure).

tasks.title: The ArduPilot baseline check tolerance
tasks.solution: Configured length = a + b (the antennas are on opposite sides of the center). In calculate_moving_base_yaw(): |offset − reported| ≤ 0.2 · min(offset, reported). If the actual mismatch is larger, no heading is output (GPS2_RAW.yaw = 65535).

tasks.title: RTCM latency budget for a moving base
tasks.solution: T = 1000/f ms; the allowance is T − 50 ms: at 5 Hz that is 150 ms, at 1 Hz 950 ms. Hence a UART2↔UART2 crossover at 460800 baud for 5 Hz, and a relaxed 38400 baud for 1 Hz.
